operates.definition: A subject organisation runs or operates an object facility or site.

part_of.definition: The subject is a component of the object.

produces.definition: The subject produces the object material, as an operation, event, capability or estimate; the modality says which.

feeds_to.definition: The subject's output is planned or reported to supply the object as feed.

offtake_agreement_with.definition: The subject has an agreement under which the object takes a stated share of a material; the material is a qualifier.

sold_to.definition: The subject sold a material to the object; delivery is not implied.

arrived_at.definition: A reported shipment or cargo arrived at the object location.

routes_via.definition: A movement is planned or reported to run through the object.

supply_agreement_with.definition: The subject has a supply agreement with the object for a material named in a qualifier.

input_for.definition: The subject material is generally an input to the object process or product; not a batch lineage.

refined_into.definition: The subject material is generally processed into the object material.

carries_flow_within.definition: An estimated volume of a stated material flowed through the subject during a stated period.

bypasses.definition: The subject infrastructure can carry flow around the object chokepoint.

connects_to.definition: The subject and object are physically or operationally connected.

imports.definition: The subject country imports the object material, at a stated scope and period.

processes.definition: The subject processes the object material within a stated reporting scope; not consumption.

located_in.definition: The subject is located within the object place or system.

contributes_production_to.definition: The subject is a part of production in the object, as attributed and dated.

exports.definition: The subject country exports the object material, at a stated scope and period.

sets_production_requirement_for.definition: The subject group set a production requirement for the object.

uses.definition: The subject uses the object as a route, asset or arrangement.

serves_import_market.definition: The subject country accounts for a stated share of import volumes through the object.

alternative_to.definition: The subject is a modelled or reported alternative to the object route.

supply_route_to.definition: The subject infrastructure provides a supply route to the object destination.

holds_stocks_of.definition: The subject holds stocks of the object material at a stated date and scope.

has_processing_capacity_for.definition: The subject has processing capacity for the object material on a stated basis.

chokepoint_transit_rate.name: Total oil transit through a chokepoint, mean rate
chokepoint_transit_rate.material_basis: total oil (crude oil and petroleum liquids); do not sum overlapping routes

world_oil_supply_rate.name: World total oil supply, mean rate
world_oil_supply_rate.material_basis: total oil supply; exact liquids coverage pending source-definition review; not crude production

crude_import_rate.name: Crude oil imports, mean rate
crude_import_rate.material_basis: crude oil; differing averaging periods are preserved

crude_and_product_export_rate.name: Crude oil plus petroleum product exports, mean rate
crude_and_product_export_rate.material_basis: crude oil and petroleum products combined

forecast_crude_production_rate.name: Forecast crude oil production, mean rate
forecast_crude_production_rate.material_basis: crude oil; a forecast, attributed to its issuer

route_transit_rate.name: Oil transit by maritime route, mean rate
route_transit_rate.material_basis: total oil; routes overlap and must not be summed

commercial_crude_stocks_excl_spr.name: Commercial crude oil stocks, excluding the strategic reserve
commercial_crude_stocks_excl_spr.material_basis: crude oil; point-in-time, never summed across weeks

operable_distillation_capacity.name: Operable atmospheric crude distillation capacity
operable_distillation_capacity.material_basis: crude oil; calendar-day basis; distinct from actual input rate

refinery_utilization.name: Refinery utilization
refinery_utilization.material_basis: share of operable capacity; source definition retained

crude_import_total.name: Crude oil imports, period total
crude_import_total.material_basis: crude oil by mass; no barrel conversion; a partial fiscal year stays partial

country_crude_production_rate.name: Crude oil production by country, mean rate
country_crude_production_rate.material_basis: crude oil; same month, different entities
